name: 245. Responses function_call_arguments.done carries no item (arguments done shape)
description:
response.function_call_arguments.done is {type, sequence_number, item_id, output_index, arguments} in the OpenAI Responses streaming spec. Gemini (and Vertex Gemini, which reuses the converter) and both Bedrock Converse tool-close paths attached a partial item to it: {"call_id", "name"} with no type. Lenient clients (OpenAI SDK) ignore it; opencode v2 validates every stream event against a schema where item requires type: string, so every Gemini or Bedrock turn that made a tool call aborted with "Invalid ... openai-responses stream event". Text-only turns passed, which made it look flaky.

The fix drops the item from the done event. The only reader of that item was the /genai reverse converter, which already falls back to the name and call id it records from output_item.added.

Cases: a forced write_file call streamed on /v1/responses and /openai/v1/responses for each affected host, asserting the done event has no item, its item_id matches the function_call output_item.added, and every item on the stream has a string type (red before the fix). The /genai cases pin the regression side: the functionCall part still carries the tool name and args once the done event stops carrying them (green before and after).

/v1/chat/completions never emits this event. /anthropic and /bedrock re-render tool calls from output_item.added and the argument deltas and never read the done event, so they are covered by Go unit tests only. Bedrock Claude with a plain function tool takes the Converse path (no reasoning, context_management or invoke-only tools), which is where the stray item came from.

item.name: gemini/gemini-2.5-flash /v1/responses stream forced tool call: arguments done shape (no item, spec fields only)

body.raw: {"model":"gemini/gemini-2.5-flash","stream":true,"max_output_tokens":1024,"input":"Write the text OK to /tmp/probe.txt using the write_file tool.","tools":[{"type":"function","name":"write_file","description":"Write text content to a file","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"path":{"type":"string"},"content":{"type":"string"}},"required":["path","content"]}}],"tool_choice":"required"}

exec: var events = txt.split(/\r?\n/).filter(function (l) { return l.indexOf('data:') === 0; }).map(function (l) { return l.slice(5).trim(); }).filter(function (d) { return d && d !== '[DONE]'; }).map(function (d) { try { return JSON.parse(d); } catch (e) { return { unparsed: d }; } });
events.forEach(function (e) { if (e.type === 'response.output_item.added' && e.item && e.item.type === 'function_call') { added[e.output_index] = e.item.id; } });
pm.test('arguments done shape gemini /v1/responses: the forced write_file call streamed function_call_arguments.done', function () {
pm.test('arguments done shape gemini /v1/responses: function_call_arguments.done carries no item, only type/sequence_number/item_id/output_index/arguments', function () {
pm.expect(e, 'stray item on function_call_arguments.done (strict clients reject it): ' + wire).to.not.have.property('item');
pm.expect(e.item_id, 'item_id must match the function_call output_item.added at output_index ' + e.output_index + ': ' + wire).to.eql(added[e.output_index]);
pm.expect(function () { JSON.parse(e.arguments); }, 'arguments must be JSON: ' + wire).to.not.throw();
pm.test('arguments done shape gemini /v1/responses: every streamed event parses and every item has a string type', function () {
pm.expect(e.item && e.item.type, e.type + ' carries an item without a string type: ' + JSON.stringify(e).slice(0, 800)).to.be.a('string').that.is.not.empty;
